# mailchannels_suppression (Resource)

A suppression list entry with source `api`: MailChannels does not deliver the listed types of message to the recipient. Entries that MailChannels adds itself (hard bounces, complaints and unsubscribes) are not managed. The Email API cannot change an entry, so changing any argument replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailchannels_suppression" "example" {
  recipient         = "do-not-email@example.com"
  suppression_types = ["non-transactional"]
  notes             = "Requested by the recipient"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `recipient` (String) Email address to suppress.

### Optional

- `notes` (String) Free-form notes, up to 1024 characters.
- `suppression_types` (Set of String) Types of message to suppress: `transactional`, `non-transactional` or both. Defaults to what the Email API chooses when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the entry was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The recipient.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Suppression entries with source "api" are imported by recipient.
terraform import mailchannels_suppression.example do-not-email@example.com
```
